name: git-pr-workflow
description: Takes finished work on Boss's Mac from branch to merged pull request: branch, commit, push, open the PR, wait for CI and the Codex bot, triage by severity, merge. Use when Boss asks to commit and push, open a PR, check CI, or merge a branch.
whenNotToUse: A TestFlight upload → xcode-testflight-shipper (build numbers and the pipeline have their own rules). Writing the code itself → a CLI session on his Mac, not this. Tidying files or folders → mac-file-organizer.
stopConditions: main branch-এ সরাসরি commit করতে হচ্ছে — আগে branch
CI লাল — merge-এর কথা তোলার আগেই থামো
conflict — নিজে resolve করার চেষ্টা নয়
কোন ফাইল commit হবে সেটা অস্পষ্ট (`git status` অপ্রত্যাশিত)
